conclusion.reason: 当前圆点、内容和布局未见缺陷；此差异在既有Spin改造中已存在并通过原门禁，不应恢复旧布局或为这三张图改写基线。

metadata.reviewNote: Reviewed all 57 Apollo List images individually across mobile/tablet/desktop: content and action layout, current tokens, isolated nested lists, empty and pagination states, actual loading, scoped dark/compact/combined themes, visible native Tab focus and corrected fullscreen document flow. Rejected the prior 3 fullscreen overlap images. Clean 5336ff77 recapture matches every reviewed SHA-256. Actual state, geometry and full axe checks passed; Chrome 150 darwin/x64. This approves this matrix only.

actualVisualReview.observation: Workspace / Review queue / Records、Alpha/Beta/Gamma、Updating queue 完整；原图与当前图的文字、分隔线、淡化正文、留白及加载层位置无可见异常。8倍最近邻图显示差异仅在四个浅蓝圆点的抗锯齿外缘，圆点数量、颜色核心与形状保持。未发现裁切、重叠或缺失。

measuredGeometry.interpretation: 新居中路径使指示器盒子横向坐标增加1/128 CSS px；纵坐标及20×20尺寸不变。这是亚像素坐标/paint路径变化，没有整像素位移。不要仅凭该微小坐标差断言所有边缘差异都由平移单独造成。

timingEvidence.note: 稳定化CSS为animation:none !important、transition:none !important；四点均animationName=none，旋转固定45deg，点缩放固定0.75且opacity=0.3。animationPlayState字段可为running，但animationName=none且document.getAnimations()为空，不代表实际动画在运行。

counterfactual.scope: 只在诊断浏览器页面插入CSS/移除包装；未写回源码，所有context已关闭。
counterfactual.conclusion: 保持当前生产bundle和组件节点，仅恢复旧section定位就逐RGBA恢复原批准图；再移除新indicator包装仍零差异。单加identity transform不改变当前像素。定位与绘制路径已足够解释差异，加载时序不能解释稳定的旧/新像素切换。
